x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change bodies-board-composition-skills-and-diversity (REQ-BCS-001 to REQ-BCS-004; matrix rows bod-11 and bod-12). the competences a body needs, the competences its members hold, and the diversity targets the body sets itself. The skills matrix and the composition figures are computed in the GovernanceBodyCompositionTab widget; they are not declared aggregations, because each figure groups persons reached through a membership and each gap compares a count on one schema with a number on another.

BoardCompetence.title: Board competence
BoardCompetence.description: A competence a body needs among its members, such as Finance and audit, and how many members should hold it.
BoardCompetence._authorizationNote: Every signed-in member reads competences. Writes are owned by MemberCompetenceController, which lets only users in the body's signatory scope (or an administrator) create and change a body's competences and saves in system context. OpenRegister cannot express a per-body scope group in a static block, so the write verbs are left out on purpose (RegisterAuthorizationTest, SERVICE_OWNED_WRITES_STAY_CLOSED).

governanceBody.title: Body
governanceBody.description: The body that needs this competence.

name.title: Name
name.description: The competence, such as Finance and audit or Water management.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the body expects of a member who holds this competence.

requiredHolders.title: Required holders
requiredHolders.description: How many members should hold this competence confirmed at level experienced or expert.

order.title: Order
order.description: The position of the competence among the body's columns in the skills matrix.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the body still needs this competence. An inactive competence leaves the skills matrix but keeps its history.

MemberCompetence.title: Member competence
MemberCompetence.description: A competence a member brings to the body they sit on, at a level, and whether a signatory of the body confirmed it.
MemberCompetence._authorizationNote: Every signed-in member reads member competences. Writes are owned by MemberCompetenceController: a member records their own competence, a signatory of the membership's body records one for any member, and only that signatory confirms one; changing the level clears the confirmation. It saves in system context, and the write verbs are left out on purpose so the object API cannot set confirmedBy around that check.

membership.title: Membership
membership.description: The membership the competence counts for. It ends with the membership.

competence.title: Competence
competence.description: The competence of the membership's body.

level.title: Level
level.description: How far the member brings the competence: basic, experienced or expert.

note.title: Note
note.description: Where the competence comes from, such as a former position or a qualification.

confirmedBy.title: Confirmed by
confirmedBy.description: The Nextcloud account of the signatory who confirmed the competence. Empty while unconfirmed.

confirmedAt.title: Confirmed at
confirmedAt.description: When the competence was confirmed. Empty while unconfirmed.

diversityTargets.title: Diversity targets
diversityTargets.description: The minimum shares the body sets itself for the make-up of its current members, such as at least a third women.

dimension.title: Dimension
dimension.description: What the target counts: gender, age band, nationality or independence.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value counted, as stored on the person or membership, such as female or independent.

minimumShare.title: Minimum share
minimumShare.description: The smallest share of current members with that value, between 0 and 1.
